requiredFindings.title: A non-format-3 file with no floor is floorLost
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The namespace contains a complete format-1 grant-journal.sqlite and no floor. The floor-step table matches floor absent and anything other than no carrier and no witness, so the open reports floorLost: LEDGER.CORRUPT, ledger-corrupt, domainDetail omitted. F46's HOST.IO_FAILURE never runs. A partial format-3 object set takes the same row instead of MIGRATION.CORRUPT.

requiredFindings.title: The floor table does not implement the crash list
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The first operation commits a record and publishes a floor with lastSeq above 0. The next start matches the fourth row, whose condition is a present floor and no carrier, a witness, or lastSeq above 0, and quarantines uncertainTailLoss without comparing the healthy carrier. If that row is read as the absent-carrier case only, a carrier with records and no witness takes the compare row, the floor moves up to that tail, and witnesslessRestore then leaves the raised floor in place.

scope: Law X3b r2. r1 RF-1, RF-2, and RF-4 are closed. r1 RF-3 is not: the floor-absent row classifies a format-1 file and a partial format-3 set as floorLost. The floor table quarantines a healthy advanced floor or raises the floor over a witnessless tail. No product cargo.
